60700.meaning1: practicing correctly; going the right way; performing correctly
60700.commentary: (PVa) sammaggate'ti sammā gate sammā paṭipanne sammā paṭipannāya.

examples.text: evarūpe kho, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo satthari pasādo so na sammaggato akkhāyati, yo dhamme pasādo so na sammaggato akkhāyati, yā sīlesu paripūrakāritā sā na sammaggatā akkhāyati, yā sahadhammikesu piyamanāpatā sā na sammaggatā akkhāyati.
aj'eḷakā ca gāvo ca, vividhā yattha haññare, na taṃ sammaggatā yaññaṃ, upayanti mah'esino.

60701.meaning1: who has practiced correctly; perfected; epithet of the Buddha and awakened beings
60701.meaning2: who has come to the right path
60701.commentary: (SNa) sammaggatā'ti sammā paṭipannā buddh'ādayo. (PMa) sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā'ti anulomapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā dhammikasamaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ n'atthī'ti gaṇhāti.

examples.text: atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ'ca lokaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti
sammaggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa hitassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
so āsanāni paṭisāmeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ paṭisāmeti, bhatt'aggaṃ sammajjati
okāsa! sammajjanī, sammajjanakaraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? sammajjanakaraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: taṇ'ṭhānasammajjanañ'ca, tattha padīp'ujjalanañ'ca, āsanapaññapanañ'ca
sammajjanī padīpo ca, udakaṃ āsanena ca, uposathassa etāni, pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

60708.grammar: prp of caus of saṃ √majj, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: sodhento'ti uyyānamaggaṃ samaṃ kāretvā antouyyāne tacchitabbayuttaṭṭhānāni tacchāpento sammajjitabbayuttāni ṭhānāni sammajjāpento vālukāokiraṇa-pupphavikiraṇa-puṇṇaghaṭaṭṭhapana-kadalikkhandhaṭhapan'ādīni ca karonto'ti attho.

60711.meaning1: should be swept; should be cleaned

examples.text: upajjhāyamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ. sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo.

atha kho upāli gahapati, yaṃ sudaṃ pubbe yato passati nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ disvāna tato paccuggantvā yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañ'ca seṭṭhañ'ca uttamañ'ca paṇītañ'ca taṃ uttar'āsaṅgena sammajjitvā pariggahetvā nisīdāpeti

60713.commentary: (VINa) pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā'ti sace pāto asammaṭṭhaṃ sammaṭṭham'pi vā puna tiṇapaṇṇ'ādīhi uklāpaṃ pādappahārehi ca vikiṇṇavālikaṃ jātaṃ, sammajjitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tena sammatena bhikkhunā pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññapetvā dutiyaṃ gahetvā nisīditabbaṃ.
kammasamayo nāma antamaso pariveṇam'pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

60715.meaning1: considered as; deemed to be; thought to be; said to be; regarded as; agreed to be

examples.text: mokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.
sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.
sammato'pi ce bhikkhu atthaṅ'gate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
atthi pana, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito, ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti, yaṃ tumhe eta'r'ahi paṭipādeyyāthā'ti?

60717.synonym: anavamata, garukata, garusammata, purakkhata, pūjita, mahita, māhita, sakkata, sambhāvita

60719.meaning1: is calmed; is cooled; is appeased

examples.text: akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me, ye ca taṃ upanayhanti, veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
accayo ce na vijjetha, no'c'idh'āpagataṃ siyā, verāni na ca sammeyyuṃ, ken'īdha kusalo siyā'ti.
atha kho, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko amacce pārisajje āmantesi, kahaṃ nu kho, bho, eta'r'ahi kumārā sammantī'ti?

60721.meaning1: common knowledge; popular understanding; general consensus

examples.text: cattāri ñāṇāni, dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, pariye ñāṇaṃ, sammatiñāṇaṃ.
cattāri ñāṇāni, dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, pariye ñāṇaṃ, sammatiñāṇaṃ.

60723.commentary: (DNa) aññataro theranāmako bhikkhū'ti evaṃ theranāmako vā, yaṃ vā pana mahallakakāle pabbajitaṃ sāmaṇer'ādayo disvā thero thero'ti vadanti, ayaṃ sammutithero nāma.

examples.text: tayo therā, jātithero, dhammathero, sammatithero.

60724.commentary: (ANa) kodhasammadasammatto'ti kodhamadena matto, ādinna-gahita-parāmaṭṭho'ti attho. (DHPa) taṃ puttapasusammattan'ti taṃ rūpabal'ādisampanne putte ca pasū ca labhitvā mama puttā abhirūpā balasampannā paṇḍitā sabbakiccasamatthā, mama goṇā abhirūpā arogā mahābhāravahā, mama gāvī bahukhīrā'ti evaṃ puttehi ca pasūhi ca sammattaṃ naraṃ.

examples.text: taṃ puttapasusammattaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.
kodhasammadasammatto, āyasakyaṃ nigacchati, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, parivajjanti kodhanaṃ.

60725.commentary: (ANa) niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattan'ti kusalesu dhammesu magganiyāmasaṅkhātaṃ sammattaṃ.

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo labhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya alabhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya, labhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya alabhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya n'eva okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.

60726.meaning1: with fixed destiny in goodness; with inevitable results from rightness

examples.text: micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā

60727.meaning1: path with an inevitable destination; fixed correct course; (comm) noble path

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.
kodhasammadasammatto, āyasakyaṃ nigacchati, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, parivajjanti kodhanaṃ.

60729.meaning1: drowsiness after eating; languor after a meal

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, arati tandī vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ.
anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?
ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

60731.grammar: ger of sammā ājānāti, comp vb

examples.text: tesaṃ sampannasīlānaṃ, appamādavihārinaṃ, samma'd'aññā vimuttānaṃ, māro maggaṃ na vindati.
yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā, paravādesu na nīyare, te sambuddhā samma'd'aññā, caranti visame saman'ti.

60732.meaning1: supreme gnosis; perfect knowledge; complete understanding; full awakening

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti

60733.grammar: ger of sammā ājānāti, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ārogyaṃ samma'd'aññāya, āsavānaṃ parikkhayā, saṅkhāya sevī dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ n'opeti vedagū'ti.
anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.

60734.meaning1: who is liberated by perfect understanding; who is freed through complete comprehension; epithet of an arahant
60734.commentary: (SNa) sammā kāraṇehi jānitvā vimuttā'ti samma'd'aññāvimuttā. maggapaññāya catusaccadhammaṃ ñatvā phalavimuttiyā vimuttā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti

khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya, diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.

sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā, imasmiṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti

acir'ūpasampanno kho pan'āyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
evaṃ vutte, upāli gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sādhu sādhu, bhante tapassī! yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma'd'eva satthusāsanaṃ ājānantena evam'evaṃ dīghatapassinā nigaṇṭhena bhagavato byākataṃ.
omaddantī'ti sammaddanti. na ca acchinne theve pakkamitun'ti yāva rajanabindu gaḷitaṃ na chijjati, tāva na aññatra gantabbaṃ.

manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni ca sammaddantā, ek'indriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā'ti!

60741.commentary: (ITIa) sammaddaso'ti sabbāsaṃ vedanānaṃ catunnam'pi vā saccānaṃ aviparītadassāvī. (SNPa) sammaddasā'ti sammādassanā.

examples.text: sammaddasā vedaguno, samma'd'aññāya paṇḍitā, abhibhuyya mārasaṃyogaṃ, na gacchanti punabbhavan'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu niranusayo sammaddaso acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti.

60744.meaning1: having scoured; having scrubbed together; having rubbed together

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ. tam'enaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anupadajjuṃ. tam'enaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā sammadditvā acche udake vikkhāleti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, assalāyana, sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu sammantānaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo

60754.commentary: (VINa) sīmaṃ sammannatī'ti navaṃ sīmaṃ bandhati. kurundiyaṃ pana udak'ukkhepaparicchindane'pi dukkaṭaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.
yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma, yo no sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, sammā garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya. mayaṃ pan'assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmā'ti.

60758.meaning1: should be authorized; should be appointed; should be elected; should be chosen

examples.text: sace sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, sabbena saṅghena oloketabbaṃ. no ce sabbo saṅgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, ye tattha honti bhikkhū byattā paṭibalā sārambhaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanaṃ jānituṃ te yācitvā sammannitabbā.

60759.meaning1: to authorize; to appoint; to elect; to choose

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhun'ovādakaṃ sammannituṃ.

60762.commentary: (DNa) sammapekkhantī'ti sammā pekkhanti. (JAa) sammapekkhantī'ti sammā nayena kāraṇena pekkhanti.

examples.text: yasmā ca saṅgahā ete, sammapekkhanti paṇḍitā, tasmā mahattaṃ papponti, pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te'ti.

60763.meaning1: knowing perfectly; clearly comprehending; perfectly understanding

examples.text: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.

tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ
bhūtam'idan'ti, sāriputta, passasī'ti? bhūtam'idan'ti, bhante, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.

60765.grammar: fem, comp, instr sg of sammappaññā
60765.meaning1: with correct understanding; with perfect wisdom

examples.text: lokasamudayaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke n'atthitā sā na hoti. lokanirodhaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti.
sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, sammappadhānāni. katamāni cattāri?

60767.meaningLit: connected with the correct application of effort

60768.meaningLit: discourse on the correct application of effort

60769.meaningLit: discourse on the correct application of effort

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, sammasatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, antaraṃ sammasan'ti.

60772.meaning2: grasps, touches, knows thoroughly, meditates on

examples.text: yato yato sammasati, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, labhatī pītipāmojjaṃ, amataṃ taṃ vijānataṃ.
bhagavā etadavoca, sammasatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, antaraṃ sammasan'ti.

kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.

akammaṃ h'etaṃ, mahārāja, jinaputtānaṃ yadidaṃ pūjā, sammasanaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ, yoniso manasikāro, satipaṭṭhān'ānupassanā, ārammaṇasāraggāho, kilesayuddhaṃ, sadattham'anuyuñjanā, etaṃ jinaputtānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, avasesānaṃ devamanussānaṃ pūjā karaṇīyā.
kālena dhammassavanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, kālena sammasanā, kālena vipassanā

60778.commentary: (THa) sammasanto khandhānaṃ udayabbayan'ti pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ udayabbayañ'ca vipassanto, yadi'pi idāni katakicco, phalasamāpattiṃ pana samāpajjituṃ vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapento'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho veḷugumbasmiṃ, bhutvāna madhupāyasaṃ, padakkhiṇaṃ sammasanto, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, sānuṃ paṭigamissāmi, vivekam'anubrūhayan'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammasamāno sammasati antaraṃ sammasaṃ, yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ.

60781.meaning2: grasped, touched, knew thoroughly, meditated on

60782.meaning2: grasped, touched, known thoroughly, meditated on

examples.text: jātijarāmaraṇavasena visuṃ sammasan'ābhāve'pi jāti-jarā-maraṇa-vantesu'y'eva pana sammasitesu tāni'pi sammasitāni hontī'ti pariyāyena tesam'pi vasena sammasanaṃ vuttan'ti veditabbaṃ.

60783.meaning1: should be grasped; should be understood; should be known
60783.commentary: (ANa) evaṃ kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā'ti-ādīsu, āvuso, saṅkhārā nāma aniccato daṭṭhabbā, aniccato sammasitabbā, aniccato passitabbā. tathā dukkhato, anattato'ti evaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: kathaṃ nu kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā? kathaṃ saṅkhārā sammasitabbā? kathaṃ saṅkhārā vipassitabbā'ti?

60784.meaning1: to grasp; to understand; to thoroughly know

60785.meaning1: having grasped; having understood; having thoroughly known

examples.text: tvaṃ āvikarohi bhūmipāla, bhattā bhārasaho tuvaṃ vade taṃ, tava chandarucīni sammasitvā, atha vakkhanti jan'inda pañca dhīrā.

60787.meaning1: is properly digested; is thoroughly digested

examples.text: na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.

60788.synonym: asesato, asesaṃ, ekantaṃ, kevalaṃ, paripūraṃ, sādhukaṃ

examples.text: yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.

na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
sa ve vidvā sa vedagū, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito, sammā so loke iriyāno, na pihet'īdha kassaci.
etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi. ayaṃ kho sā, āvuso, majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

60791.meaning1: correct livelihood; right mode of earning a living

examples.text: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

60792.meaning1: with correct livelihood; having right mode of earning a living

examples.text: pare micchāājīvā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāājīvā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
pare micchākamm'antā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammākamm'antā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60795.meaning1: correct livelihood; maintaining one's life in the correct way

examples.text: micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, etth'ete akusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti
sammāvāyāmassa sammāsati pahoti, sammāsatissa sammāsamādhi pahoti, sammāsamādhissa sammāñāṇaṃ pahoti, sammāñāṇassa sammāvimutti pahoti

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.

60797.meaning1: with correct understanding; with right wisdom
60797.commentary: (MNa) sammāñāṇī'ti ettha pana ek'ūnavīsatibhedaṃ paccavekkhaṇāñāṇaṃ sammāñāṇan'ti vuccati, tena samannāgatā puggalā sammāñāṇī.

examples.text: pare micchāñāṇī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāñāṇī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60798.commentary: (PMa) tena vuccati sammādassanan'ti tena yathābhūtajānanena taṃ ñāṇaṃ sammādassanan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sammādassanaṃ pana, bhante, kim'atthiyan'ti? sammādassanaṃ kho, rādha, nibbid'atthaṃ. nibbidā pana, bhante, kim'atthiyā'ti?
anattato manasikaronto nimittañ'ca pavattañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, tena vuccati, sammādassanaṃ. evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe dhammā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti.

60799.meaning1: right view; correct outlook; correct belief

examples.text: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
